1 جَلِهَ , aor.
جَلَهَ , (S, Msb, K,) inf. n. جَلَهٌ, (Sudot;, * Msb, TA,) He was, or became, bald in the fore part of the head: (S, K:) or in the greater part of his head. (Msb.) [The latter seems to be the correct meaning: see جَلَهٌ below.] ―
-b2- جَلِهَتْ سَاحَتُهُ His court, or yard, was, or became, vacant, or void. (JK.) ＝
-A2- جَلَهَ, (S, K,) aor.
جَلَهَ , (K,) inf. n. جَلْهٌ, (TA,) He uncovered a thing; or removed it [from a thing that it covered or concealed]. (K, TA.) ―
-b2- He raised the turban, while folding it, from the side of his forehead (عَنْ جَبِينِهِ), (K, TA,) [like اِجْتَلَى,] and from the fore part of his head. (TA.) ―
-b3- He removed the pebbles from a place. (S, K.) ―
-b4- He turned back a person from a difficult, or hard, thing or affair. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
